About.Credits: Developed by ajaykontham. DevDX is free and open source under the MIT License, and bug reports and feature requests are welcome on GitHub.
About.PrivacyDesc: What DevDX does and doesn't do with your data.
About.PrivacyLocalBody: Your dock items, layout and settings are saved locally to %AppData%\DevDX and never leave your device.
About.PrivacyOfflineBody: Every tool runs locally on your PC. Nothing you paste, open or convert is ever sent anywhere.
About.PrivacyTrackingBody: No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics, no ads.
About.Tagline: A floating dock of developer tools for Windows 11, built with WinUI 3.
Add.Separator.Hint: Adds a thin divider to the dock so you can group icons visually. It has no target and clicking it does nothing — drag it to position it like any other item.

Backup.ConfirmBody: Importing replaces the dock, every pinned tool and every setting with the ones in the file. This can’t be undone — export your current dock first if you want to keep it.

Reset.Body: This removes every tool you’ve pinned and restores the dock DevDX ships with. This can’t be undone.
Reset.Title: Reset dock to defaults?
Search.Title: DevDX Search
Settings.AccentTintDesc: Tint the glass with your Windows accent colour instead of the taskbar's neutral grey.
Settings.AlwaysOnTopDesc: Keep the dock above other windows while it's floating. (When snapped it's always on top.)
Settings.AutoHideDesc: Slide behind the edge and reveal on hover. A notch marks where it is.
Settings.BackupDesc: Save the dock, its tools and every setting to a file, or restore one — the way to move DevDX to another PC.
Settings.DensityDesc: How big the dock's icons and cells are. Medium matches the Windows 11 taskbar.
Settings.GlassDesc: How frosted the dock's acrylic is. Lower lets more of the desktop show through.
Settings.HotkeyDesc: A system-wide shortcut that brings the dock to the front — including when it is tucked behind a screen edge.
Settings.ItemHotkeysDesc: Let individual items have their own system-wide shortcut, assigned from an icon's right-click menu. Off by default, since each one claims a combination from every other app.
Settings.LanguageDesc: The language DevDX's own windows and menus use. It applies straight away.
Settings.MagnifyDesc: Swell icons as the cursor passes over them, macOS-dock style. The swell stays inside the strip, so the dock never changes size.
Settings.OpenIndicatorsDesc: Show a dot under a tool that already has a window open. With “Reuse the open window” on, clicking it brings that window forward instead of opening a second one.
Settings.PositionDesc: Float freely, or snap flush to a screen edge.
Settings.ResetSectionDesc: Remove every pinned tool and restore the dock DevDX ships with.
Settings.ReuseToolWindows: Reuse the open window for a tool
Settings.ReuseToolWindowsDesc: Clicking a tool focuses its most recently opened window instead of opening a fresh one. Shift+click always opens a new one.
Settings.SearchHotkeyDesc: A system-wide shortcut that opens a search box over your pinned items. Off until you assign one.
Settings.StartupBlocked: Windows is blocking DevDX from starting at sign-in. Turn it back on under Startup apps in Task Manager or Windows Settings.
Settings.StartupDesc: Launch DevDX automatically when you sign in.
Settings.ThemeDesc: Choose a light or dark look, or follow your Windows setting.
Settings.Title: DevDX Settings
Settings.TransposeDesc: When the dock is snapped to the left or right edge, stack its icons vertically. Top, bottom and floating stay horizontal.
Settings.UpdatesDesc: Ask GitHub whether a newer DevDX has been released. Off by default — it is the only thing DevDX ever sends over the network, and nothing is downloaded or installed for you.
Shortcuts.NoneAssigned: No item has a shortcut yet. Right-click an icon on the dock and choose “Shortcut” to give it one.
